scope: Sparse every20frame residues1/2, six training videos. Four adapter and two actual backbone fits: outerSN015, innerBT001, other4fit; fixed last8epochs. Not full-fold/three-seed, full-video MOT, or raw online runtime.

config.frame_selection: All six training videos: every20frame pair1/2, retaining same-frame crowded sets, adjacent pairs, medium/long past gaps. This is a preregistered sparse crop identity pilot, not full detector-feature or online throughput measurement.
config.precision: AMP matches inherited detector feature producer; normalized features stored float32, local/rawImageNet tokens float16
encoders: Frozen ImageNet ResNet50, no fish fitting
config.training_scope: Features are current GT/detector crops for offline training/diagnosis only. New adapters must exclude distinct outer and inner calibration videos; old fish encoder exposure remains explicit.
config.inherited_numeric_parity: Selected same detector boxes/features compare max component error and cosine error with exact old bank; AMP batch composition differences reported, never asserted byte equality.

crop_cache.scope: Same registered sparse GT/detector current crops/order storedfloat16 for newImageNet-initialized visual fitting. No new image or detector proposals. Outer/inner exclusions enforced by trainers; noIR read.

config.folds: Outer each video; inner next video in this declared cycle; fit other4. No outer/inner fish-gradient fitting, no historical dev/test.
config.checkpoint_selection: Fixed epoch8; inner/outer retrieval after training only, no parameter/checkpoint choice from heldout results.
config.sampler: Uniform fit video then real GT frame with>=2fish, max8different physicalIDs; each contributes same-frame anchor plus3known same-fish GT/det observations >=25frames away. Short histories retain anchor but loss excludes unsupported temporal positives.
config.representation: Stopped current ImageNet ResNet50 rawglobal2048 and geometricK8strip2048; existing fish-trained columns are never loaded. New trained256coordinate, no old512GRU use.
config.comparisons: Global projection, equal-two-projection dualglobal capacity control, simple local pooling, learned local weighting. K4/full-backbone/DINO/FishMAE/FDTA controls remain separately pending.
config.scope: First registered sparse visual/local adapter experiment. Excludes both outer/inner new fish fitting. ImageNet external pretrain overlap and old detector exposure disclosed; full native MOT/complete raw cost not yet measured.
config.resume: Atomic epoch model/optimizer/scheduler/Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG plus exact source/config/feature/runtime/GPU guards
